title: Merge-Based Vocabulary Extension Stalls at the Pre-Tokenizer: An English-Preserving Repair for Nepali, Tested in Continued Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2610.33016v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Llama-3, Qwen3 and many other open LLMs pre-tokenize text with a regular expression whose word class admits only Unicode letters. Devanagari vowel signs are combining marks, so this regex splits Nepali words at every vowel sign, and models that use it spend 2.6 to 5.8 times as many tokens on Nepali as on the same English text. Merge-based vocabulary extension cannot join the split pieces: for Llama-3 and Qwen3 no number of new merges brings this premium below about 2.2, and ten released extensions already end within 4% of this pre-token floor. We give a small edit to the deployed regex that provably keeps every token id of text without combining marks or Devanagari characters. With 32,000 new merges it brings Nepali to 1.01 times English, about 54% fewer Nepali tokens than standard extension. translated_title: 基于合并的词表扩展在预分词器处停滞：一种保留英文的尼泊尔语修复方案及其在持续预训练中的验证
translated_abstract: Llama-3、Qwen3 以及许多其他开源大语言模型使用一个正则表达式对文本进行预分词，其词类仅允许 Unicode 字母。天城文元音符号属于组合附加符号，因此该正则表达式会在每个元音符号处切分尼泊尔语单词，导致使用该正则的模型在尼泊尔语文本上消耗的 token 数量是相同英文文本的 2.6 到 5.8 倍。基于合并的词表扩展无法将切分后的片段重新连接：对于 Llama-3 和 Qwen3，无论添加多少新合并规则，都无法将这一溢价降至约 2.2 以下，而十个已发布的扩展版本最终已达到距此预分词下限 4% 以内的水平。我们对已部署的正则表达式做了一个小修改，并证明该修改能完整保留不含组合附加符号或天城文字符的文本的每一个 token id。通过 32,000 条新合并规则，它将尼泊尔语的 token 开销降至英文的 1.01 倍，比标准扩展方法减少约 54% 的尼泊尔语 token。在 Llama-3.2-1B 和 Qwen3-0.6B 的小预算持续预训练中，原始分词器在保留集尼泊尔语每字节数上取得了最低值（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 论文发现基于合并的词表扩展受预分词正则表达式的瓶颈限制，并提出一个可证明保留英文 token 不变的小型正则修复，使尼泊尔语 token 开销从英文的 2.2 倍以上降至 1.01 倍，比标准扩展减少约 54% 的 token。
en_tdlr: Merge-based vocabulary extension is capped by the pre-tokenizer regex, and a small regex repair that provably preserves all English token ids reduces Nepali token overhead from over 2.2× English to 1.01×, about 54% fewer tokens than standard extension.
